sloka: ददर्श कपि शार्दूल मयूरान् कुक्कुटामः तथा ।वराह वार्ध्राणसकान् दधि सौवर्चल आयुतान् ॥५-११-१३॥
transliteration: dadarśa kapi śārdūla mayūrān kukkuṭāmaḥ tathā ।varāha vārdhrāṇasakān dadhi sauvarcala āyutān ॥5-11-13॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the meat of pigs and jungle fowls, deer, peacocks and bones marinated with yoghurt and special kinds of salt.
